newsitem.title: USA: Kansas cattle trade at $73 for small amount - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas cattle trade at $73 for small amount - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow. Not enough slaughter steers or heifers sold for a market test.

Inquiry moderate, demand light. Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 300 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 15,000 head confirmed, including 8600 head or about 57 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Confirmed: 500 Last week: 40,000 Last year: 27,800
Week-to-date: 15,000 Last week: 53,200 Last year: 35,000 Slaughter Steers: few Select and Choice 2-3 1325 lbs 72.50-73.00.
Slaughter Heifers: few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 73.00. --Chicago newsdesk 312-408-8720--
